Every level of government — local, state, and Federal — is funding the arts bodies and councils. PROJECTION ARTIST FOR FESTIVALS

The business case for festivals is foot traffic. Local councils want it. Precinct associations want it. Sponsors want it. Projection art pulls crowds into laneways, parks, and main streets after dark — the hours retail and hospitality need most.

Want proof that this type of activation is working? In Australia, night-time pedestrian activity in Melbourne precincts now exceeds pre-pandemic levels, with the sector supporting 31,000 jobs and contributing $3.3 billion to the local economy.

A projection artist for hire is cheaper than a pyrotechnics team, safer than a fireworks permit, and reusable across multiple nights. One commission with Oddtoe. And then multiple activations in a large space, over one night or multiple nights.

That's good business math!

Treat your audiences, your fans, or your community to first-of-their-kind stories – human stories told with the help of generative A.I. software.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner]

[/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_check=”row-background-dark” dfd_enable_overlay=”” dfd_row_config=”full_width_content” dfd_row_parallax=”dfd-row-parallax” css=”.vc_custom_1776650073002{background: #0a060c url(https://www.oddtoe.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/Projection-Light-Illustration-Oddtoe.png?id=12848) !important;background-position: center !important;background-repeat: no-repeat !important;background-size: cover !important;}”][vc_column width=”3/6″]
[/vc_column][vc_column width=”2/6″]
[vc_column_text css=”.vc_custom_1776650190168{border-right-width: 30px !important;padding-right: 30px !important;}”]

PROJECTION ARTIST FOR FESTIVALS

The business case for festivals is foot traffic. Local councils want it. Precinct associations want it. Sponsors want it. Projection art pulls crowds into laneways, parks, and main streets after dark — the hours retail and hospitality need most.

Want proof that this type of activation is working? In Australia, night-time pedestrian activity in Melbourne precincts now exceeds pre-pandemic levels, with the sector supporting 31,000 jobs and contributing $3.3 billion to the local economy.

A projection artist for hire is cheaper than a pyrotechnics team, safer than a fireworks permit, and reusable across multiple nights. One commission with Oddtoe. And then multiple activations in a large space, over one night or multiple nights.

That’s good business math!

 

[/vc_column_text]

[/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/6″][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row dfd_row_config=”full_width_small_paddings” row_effect=”dfd-fade-on-scroll” dfd_row_parallax=”dfd-row-parallax” css=”.vc_custom_1682406499798{padding-right: 10px !important;padding-left: 10px !important;background-color: #0d0d0d !important;}”][vc_column]
